effect_on_reported_numbers: none: all metrics, comparisons, decisions and diagnostics were produced by the frozen training/evaluation path and by the same analysis functions except this tolerance comparison; verify_pilot.json was regenerated and reports 61/61 checks passing.
purpose: Honest record of the only source edit made AFTER the protocol freeze and after all five GPU runs.
reason: verify() reloads each CUDA-trained checkpoint on CPU and compares the reproduced Dev predictions with the stored ones. The observed maximum difference was 2.0e-6 logD (float32 reduction-order noise), so the tolerance was raised from 1e-6 to 1e-5 with an explanatory comment. No model, training, data, batching or metric code was touched; the other 9 frozen files are byte-identical.
